sql:
select
  currency_code,
  count(*) as payout_count,
  sum(gross_amount) as gross_native_total,
  sum(fee_amount) as fee_native_total,
  sum(net_amount) as net_native_total,
  sum(net_amount) - (sum(gross_amount) - sum(fee_amount)) as net_check_diff_native,
  round(
    (sum(net_amount) - (sum(gross_amount) - sum(fee_amount))) / nullif(sum(gross_amount), 0) * 100,
    2
  ) as net_check_diff_pct
from payouts
where created_at >= timestamp '2023-01-01'
  and created_at < timestamp '2026-01-01'
group by currency_code
order by payout_count desc, currency_code
note: Used payouts.created_at to scope 2023-01-01 through 2025-12-31 (no payout date column other than arrival_date/paid_at which can be null for non-arrived payouts); all amounts are summed in native currency per currency_code with no FX conversion, as requested.
